spans.s:
Dṛḍha-cyut Āgasti (‘descendant of Agastya’) is mentioned in the Jaiminīya brāhmaṇa as having been Udgātṛ priest at the Sattra (‘sacrificial session’) of the Vibhindukīyas.
Foot notes iii. 233 (Journal of the American Oriental Society, 18, 38). He is given in the Anukramaṇī (where the form of the patronymic is āgastya) as the author of Rv. ix. 25. Cf. Indische Studien, 3, 219.
